The biggest game

02The mania

The world
calls in sick

20%

above normal

GTA VI in-game: Vice City's waterfront at night. Image: Rockstar Games

Time-off requests for 19 November were about 20% higher than usual in workplace software provider UKG's analysis of a sample covering about two million US employees, as reported by The Washington Post.

iThis is a rise in time-off requests within the analysed sample. It is not a claim that 20% of American workers took leave.

Clearing the calendar

  • 7,000

    Logitech announced a day off for its 7,000 employees.

  • 4-day pass

    A US Army battalion at Fort Stewart, Georgia, offered eligible soldiers a pass aligned with the release if they re-enlisted.

  • Classrooms

    Schools in countries including the UK and Canada are preparing for mass absences.

Source: The Washington Post

From workplaces to livestreams, fans are clearing their schedules for a return to Vice City.

03The history

From pixels
to phenomenon

What began as a provocative top-down crime game in 1997 became one of the most influential entertainment franchises in the world.

  1. 1997

    Grand Theft Auto

    The original top-down game introduces its criminal sandbox.

  2. 2001

    GTA III

    A leap into an open 3D city, and a milestone for a generation of players.

  3. 2002

    Vice City

    Neon, nostalgia and a fictional Miami.

  4. 2004

    San Andreas

    A vast world of cities, culture and ambition.

  5. 2008

    GTA IV

    Liberty City reimagined for a new generation.

  6. 2013

    GTA V

    Los Santos becomes a global phenomenon: more than 30 million copies in its launch year and 200 million more since.

    Sales: The New York Times

  7. 2026

    GTA VI

    The franchise returns to Vice City, and to the fictional state of Leonida.

05The twist

Made in Scotland.
Imagined in America.

Grand Theft Auto may feel quintessentially American, but the franchise began in Scotland, where the first game was released in 1997.

Its early Scottish and English creators had no budget for research trips to the US. They built an exaggerated America from the films, music, television and popular culture that crossed the Atlantic.

Rockstar now has studios around the world, including in New York and Los Angeles. Nearly three decades on, that outsider's vision has become one of the world's most recognisable entertainment universes.

America,
as the world
imagined it.
